tags.wheelchair:description: Platform for trains to Liverpool has step-free access through ticket office. Platform for trains to Warrington and Manchester can be accessed via a poorly-signposted path from the roadbridge over the station. Ask station staff for directions.

tags.note: station here on npe - Lostock Hall station may have been moved since.
